content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Kanpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Deputy Project Manager: CA/ ICWA/ CS, Post graduate degree, or Graduate degree with 5 years of relevant experience for Post graduate degree / 8 years of relevant experience for Graduate degree.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kanpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) for filling various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under IIT Kanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Deputy Project Manager across different departments and desks at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for the Deputy Project Manager position under advertisement number P.Rect./R&D/2026/201.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 09 October 2026. Candidates must apply before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Kanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment drive is strictly online through the official website or designated application portal.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Deputy Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a CA/ICWA/CS, or a Post Graduate degree with 5 years of experience, or a Graduate degree with 8 years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from 23000 to 59000 per month with increments as specified.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for IIT Kanpur Various Posts Online Form 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to these contractual positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates will be based on a written test or interview as deemed appropriate by the institution.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply for IIT Kanpur Recruitment?
faq.answer: You can access the official website of IIT Kanpur at https://www.iitk.ac.in to review details and complete your application process.
